# solana-vanity

> Open-source Solana vanity address generator: WebAssembly Ed25519 grinding in the browser, an exact Base58 difficulty model, signed proof-of-grind certificates and trustless split-key delegation.

solana-vanity is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
